g.text: POST /v1/internal/join, TLS pinned to invite fingerprint
validate fields, key, peer id, signer count
read secrets, trust anchor, own WG identity
DELETE unfinished rows at this IP; DELETE node_credentials

text.tspan: INSERT wireguard_peers (confirmed_at NULL), retry on wg_ip conflict;
release the token if that fails for another reason

g.text: ask local Kubo and IPFS Cluster for peer ids (5 s each)
wg_ip, peers, secrets, bootstrap, archive signers
ping join node over the tunnel (30 s)
